inference_warnings.message: The target on "Monthly churn" can't be scored, and two separate things have to change before it can be. First, your target is stated in % while "Monthly churn" is measured in % per month, so scaling the target against that factor would silently change what you asked for into a target about a different quantity. Second, "Monthly churn" is calculated from the factors feeding into it, so the analysis produces a modelled change for it, not a reading on the same scale as your target. Goal-fit probabilities were withheld for this run rather than computed from the wrong number. Restate the target in the same units as "Monthly churn" — or set that factor's unit to match your target — and state it as the change you want from today rather than as an absolute level, which is the form "Monthly churn" can be scored against.
